answer: Ferrous Residency Witness. Each identity must continuously prove its physical host occupies a unique, fixed location: a low-power ferrous resonator embedded in the hardware emits a location-bound signature that drifts in a predictable spiral as temperature and age change. A lagoon-side observer station cross-checks that drift against its own reference. Attacker cost: one distinct physical site and resonator per identity, plus continuous power and calibration, since relocating breaks the spiral match.
